name: Defender and AV Alerts
description: Microsoft Defender detections and actions, attack-surface-reduction, network-protection and controlled-folder-access blocks, real-time protection turned off, configuration and exclusion changes, tamper protection, quarantine restores and history deletion. Scan start/stop, signature updates and heartbeats are left out.
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)
